blocks.x: We check your child's current visa and its conditions, confirm the sponsor's status, list the documents you need and lodge the application. Bring your child's visa grant, passports and any court orders to your first appointment in Melbourne (Collins St) or Adelaide (Gawler Pl), or speak to us by phone or video.

The 445 is temporary. When the permanent partner visa stage is decided, the child's long-term position needs to be dealt with. See [Partner Provisional Visa 309](/family-visa/partner-provisional-visa-subclass-309), [Partner Provisional Visa 820](/family-visa/partner-provisional-visa-subclass-820), [Partner Permanent Visa 100](/family-visa/partner-permanent-visa-subclass-100) and [Partner Permanent Visa 801](/family-visa/partner-permanent-visa-subclass-801).

items.x: **Applying under the wrong visa.** If your partner has become an Australian citizen, a partner visa may be needed.
**Weak relationship evidence.** Provide proof that the relationship is genuine and continuing.
**Visa expires before lodging.** Apply well before your current visa ends.
**Assuming the visa leads to permanent residence.** It does not on its own. See what happens after the 461 below.

The test looks at your close family, which can include your parents, siblings, children and stepchildren. In broad terms, you must show that your closest family are all settled in Australia, or that you have no close family elsewhere. A single brother or sister overseas can stop your application.
This test is the main reason applications fail. Do not rely on a quick online checklist. Book a consultation so we can map your whole family.

what-does-the-test-look-at.h2: What does the test look at?

blocks.x: The Department looks at your parents, brothers, sisters and children, and sometimes step-relatives. If a relative lives overseas, the test may not be met. If a relative has died, you will need proof.
Because the test is so detailed, we draw up a family map with you before advising.
Only a limited number of places are available each year. Many applicants live on a bridging visa for years. Ask yourself whether that suits your life, then talk to us.

costs-that-are-not-the-visa-charge.h2: Costs that are not the visa charge

items.x: **Assurance of support.** A sponsor, usually your child, may need to provide an assurance of support and a bond for several years.
**Health examinations.** Panel doctor fees vary by country and age.
**Health insurance.** Cover for the visa holder may be needed.
**Police certificates and translations.** Fees vary by country.
**Travel and living costs.** Plan for flights, housing and daily costs.
**Professional fees.** See our professional fees below.

does-starting-on-a-temporary-visa-cost-m.h2: Does starting on a temporary visa cost more?

blocks.x: The temporary contributory visas allow a parent to stay in Australia for a limited period while the permanent application is being considered. Costs can add up if you apply for both stages. Ask us to add the stages together for your case. See also [Sponsored Parent Temporary Visa 870](/family-visa/sponsored-parent-temporary-visa-subclass-870) as a shorter option.
